verdict.rationale: Obsidian stores notes as local plain-text Markdown files in a vault, explicitly marketed for offline use and long-term data ownership independent of the app, and community users confirm files persist locally and outlive the app. Minor caveat: Canvas introduces a JSON (non-Markdown) format, though still local and open-sourced. Missing for 10: independent verification of full offline functionality parity (e.g., all plugins working offline) and more detail on edge cases like mobile sync reliability.
